h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kakinada

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kakinada

items.pText: Kakinada is a port city on the Godavari delta coast, with fertiliser plants, a planned layout and a hot, humid climate shaped by the Bay of Bengal. Schools, colleges, housing societies and municipal parks here ask us for playground equipment. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 1,020 km away, and sends it to Andhra Pradesh by road.

Some schools and parks ask for play areas that children with disabilities can enjoy alongside their friends. A few simple choices make a big difference: a smooth path to the equipment, play panels at ground level and swings with proper support. Our design team can customise structures on request, so tell us about the children who will use the space. We will suggest pieces and a layout that let more of them join in.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Making a play area easier for every child to use

c: Lay a firm, level path from the gate to the play area, with no steps, and run rubber flooring right up to it so a wheelchair or walker can reach the equipment. Choose some activities that work from the ground, such as play panels and low climbers. A mother-and-child swing lets a parent or carer swing together with a child who needs support. Keep quieter pieces away from busy ones for children who find crowds hard. In Kakinada's coastal air, galvanised frames resist rust.

items.q: Can you plan a playground that children with disabilities can use?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about the children who will use it. We suggest ground-level activities, supportive swings and a step-free path, and our design team can customise structures on request.
Rubber flooring laid on a firm, level base gives a smooth surface that wheels can cross, unlike sand or loose soil. Join it to a step-free path from the gate.

Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Kakinada by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh. We can also suggest pieces for a mixed group of children when you share their ages and needs.
